brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.requirement: Storage box - enclosed container with usable interior storage
requirements.evidence: Two-storey hex base (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full) with bottom cover (cover:0,0,0;full;bottom) and bin:0,0,1~hex-bin-full inside to provide tray storage. All 12 side faces capped (cap:0,0,0;*;* and cap:0,0,1;*;*) forming closed walls; top closed by cover:0,0,1;full;top. Measure 220x218x169mm, BOM 1156g, meshClash clear.

Top cover is hex-main-cover with integrated magnetic closure: BOM lists 12x Neodymium disc magnet Ø5×1mm + 12x Steel BB 4.5mm for cover-to-base attraction; try to add magnets returned NO_CHANGE - 'the cover already has its magnets in (a cover has them unless taken out)'. Lid is cover:0,0,1;full;top, bottom is fixed cover.

finish.summary: Built a 2-high fully-enclosed hex storage box (220x218mm footprint, 169mm high) with bottom cover, full-depth bin inside, 12 edge caps closing all walls, and a top lid cover that retains its factory neodymium magnets for magnetic hold-shut. Verified magnets present in BOM and via setCoverMagnets (already fitted). lockJoints applied, check_build ok, meshClash clear.
